units.title: Algebraic expressions and equations
units.why: Algebra models unknown quantities and supports every later function topic.
principles: perform the same operation on both sides
examples: 3x+5=20 gives x=5
2(x-3)=10 gives x=8

Worked example — Challenge: solve a new algebra problem by naming the unknown, selecting a valid method, showing each algebraic step, and checking the final result with an independent representation.
misconceptions: changing a sign without applying it to every term
practice: Simplify 3x+2x-4.

Solve 2(x+5)=18.
